source_review.read_extent: Read the full relevant §1.1 range in the retrieved 42-page publisher preview: the Gaussian random-variable definitions, formal Wick powers and generating function, Theorem 1.3, and its coefficient-expansion proof.
source_review.supports: The finite Gaussian Wick convention, its dependence on covariance, and the cross-covariance identity for two Wick powers. It is the book-length independent treatment required for the A page's Gaussian/Wick interface.
source_review.limitations: This is a publisher preview, not the complete 382-page monograph. The inspected range does not prove the local massive two-dimensional logarithmic-kernel bound or a P(φ)₂ continuum interaction; those arguments and obligations are stated locally.
